description: Look up phone numbers before texting or calling: whether each is a valid number, its line type (mobile, landline, VoIP, toll-free and so on), its carrier and country, and whether it can take a text. number, or numbers (up to 20), with their country code. Runs on the brand's own Twilio (Lookup Line Type Intelligence) or Telnyx (number lookup) account, which bills each lookup; free in Hermoso. Needs Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
name: lookup_phone_number
title: Look up a phone number
